# AltSendme

> Open-source peer-to-peer file transfer over the internet. Built on Iroh. No accounts, unlimited size, E2E encrypted.

## Docs

- [Full product brief for AI systems](https://altsendme.com/llm.txt): Canonical facts, platforms, comparisons, press links
- [Website](https://altsendme.com/en): Marketing home
- [Downloads](https://altsendme.com/en/downloads): Desktop, Android, web, CLI
- [Compare](https://altsendme.com/en/compare): vs LocalSend, Blip, WeTransfer, FilePizza
- [vs LocalSend](https://altsendme.com/en/compare/localsend): LocalSend alternative for the internet
- [vs Blip](https://altsendme.com/en/compare/blip): Open-source Blip alternative
- [vs Magic Wormhole](https://altsendme.com/en/compare/wormhole): GUI alternative with resumable folders
- [vs PairDrop](https://altsendme.com/en/compare/pairdrop): Native alternative without browser WebRTC limits
- [Under the hood](https://altsendme.com/en/under-the-hood): Tickets, blobs, QUIC, relays
- [GitHub](https://github.com/tonyantony300/alt-sendme): Source code (AGPL-3.0)
- [Iroh](https://www.iroh.computer): Networking stack
- [Sendme CLI](https://www.iroh.computer/sendme): Interoperable CLI

## Optional

- [Web app](https://app.altsendme.com)
